criteria.description: GET /api/products/compare?ids=1,2 returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing a `products` array of length 2 and a `count` field equal to 2.
criteria.evidence: compare.test.ts > GET /api/products/compare > 'returns 200 with matching products for two valid ids' PASSED (pnpm test --reporter=verbose: 22/22 tests passed). Test asserts res.status === 200, res.body.products.length === 2, res.body.count === 2.

criteria.description: GET /api/products/compare?ids=1 (fewer than two IDs) returns HTTP 400.
criteria.evidence: compare.test.ts > GET /api/products/compare > 'returns 400 when fewer than two ids are provided' PASSED (pnpm test --reporter=verbose: 22/22 tests passed). Test asserts res.status === 400.

criteria.description: Each product object in the /compare response includes `id` and `name` fields.
criteria.evidence: compare.test.ts > GET /api/products/compare > 'includes id and name in each returned product' PASSED (pnpm test --reporter=verbose: 22/22 tests passed). Test asserts res.body.products.every(p => p.id && p.name).

criteria.description: GET /api/products/:id with a valid numeric product ID returns HTTP 200 with the correct product data.
criteria.evidence: pnpm test in benchmark-backend: 2 test files, 22 tests passed (0 failed). products.test.ts completed with all tests green, confirming no regression in the product routing layer.

criteria.description: GET /api/products/:id with a non-existent product ID returns HTTP 404.
criteria.evidence: pnpm test in benchmark-backend: 2 test files, 22 tests passed (0 failed). products.test.ts completed with all tests green, confirming no regression in the product routing layer.

criteria.description: Only `src/routes/apiProductRoutes.ts` is modified — no changes to `compareController.ts`, `productController.ts`, `compareService.ts`, or `productSchema.ts`.
criteria.evidence: The inject-route-order-bugs.js script confirms it only modified apiProductRoutes.ts (changing route order: /:id before /compare).
